trap.label: particípio irregular
trap.wrong: The name can’t be spoke aloud.
trap.right: The name can’t be spoken aloud.
trap.why: O português usa particípios regulares em -ido/-ado, então o aluno confunde passado e particípio de verbos irregulares (spoke × spoken).

mcq.q: Which expresses a **moral duty** in the passive?
“Songs ought to have been sung” means...
opts: they were not sung, but should have been

fix.wrong: The unread letter should have been open.
fix.right: The unread letter should have been opened.

fix.wrong: A name that cannot speak is sad.
fix.right: A name that cannot be spoken is sad.

fix.wrong: The song ought have been sung.
fix.right: The song ought to have been sung.

rewrite.prompt: Passiva: “Someone ought to have sung the songs.”
rewrite.answer: The songs ought to have been sung.
